testcase.system-out: Scenario: Pin and unpin the expanded Modify panel ✔ Given `fixtures/cad/docking-visible-solid-current.opd` is open with its visible solid in the MCAD Software ✔ And the 3D Model Modify panel is expanded with its pin control unselected ✔ When the user selects the pin control ✔ And the user clicks an empty area of the viewport ✔ Then the expanded Modify command area remains visible ✔ And the pin control is highlighted ✔ When the user selects the pin control again ✔ And the user clicks an empty area of the viewport ✔ Then the additional command area closes ✔ And the part remains active
